description_sq:
Shesim apartament te tipologjise 2+1+2 te TIRANA TOWER.
Apartamenti disponon nje siperfaqe totale prej 191.1m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 147m2. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne koridorin lidhes, ne dhomen e ndenjes bashke me kuzhinen, 2(dy dhoma gjumi 2(dy) tualete.
TIRANA TOWER, projektuar nga Oppenheim Architecture, eshte nje kulle 34-kateshe qe kombinon elegancen dhe inovacionin, duke ofruar pamje te jashtezakonshme te qytetit. Çdo kat eshte projektuar per te maksimizuar hapesiren dhe driten, duke krijuar nje ndjenje harmonie dhe lirie.
Fokusi i nderteses eshte bashkejetesa mes natyres dhe qytetit, permes kopshteve te gjelberuara dhe hapesirave te perbashketa qe ofrojne qetesi ne zemer te qytetit.
Fasada unike eshte frymezuar nga dizajni tradicional i qilimave, duke simbolizuar lidhjen mes historise dhe modernitetit. Perdorimi i betonit te pigmentuar shton nje dimension estetik dhe qendrueshmeri, duke e bere ndertesen nje veper arti.
Tirana Tower eshte nje simbol i aspiratave te qytetit per dizajn modern dhe krijimin e nje komuniteti te bashkuar.
(Ndertimi ndodhet ne faze karabinaje)
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 NEAR TIRANA TOWER
description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 typology apartment in TIRANA TOWER. The apartment has a total area of ​​191.1m2 and a net area of ​​147m2. The apartment is organized in the connecting corridor, in the living room together with the kitchen, 2 (two) bedrooms and 2 (two) bathrooms. TIRANA TOWER, designed by Oppenheim Architecture, is a 34-story tower that combines elegance and innovation, offering exceptional views of the city. Each floor is designed to maximize space and light, creating a feeling of harmony and freedom. The focus of the building is coexistence between nature and the city, through green gardens and common spaces that offer tranquility in the heart of the city. The unique facade is inspired by the traditional design of carpets, symbolizing the connection between history and modernity. The use of pigmented concrete adds an aesthetic dimension, making the building a work of art. It is a symbol of the city's aspirations for modern design (The building is in the construction stage) For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
